name: Herrencreme (German Custard Dessert)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 packets (88 g) German custard powder (e.g. Dr. Oetker)

steps: Combine milk, sugar, salt, and custard powder in a saucepan. Cook, stirring, over medium heat until it has thickened.
Place a sheet of cling film on the surface of the pudding to prevent a skin from forming, and let cool completely.
Transfer the pudding to a bowl. Stir in rum and chocolate to taste.
Chill in fridge for about 2 hours.

culture.text: Herrencreme is a German pudding. It is a vanilla pudding mixed with cream, chocolate shavings and a good amount of rum. Typically Herrencreme is a dessert eaten after a large meal, such as at a wedding.
